arabic text: (HAYE SUGHRA, HAAYE SUGHRA)\n(AKBAR KI JUDAYI ME NA JEE PAYEGI SUGHRA)\nO SUGHRA, O SUGHRA
english translation text: SUGHRA WILL NOT BE ABLE TO LIVE BEING SEPARATED FROM AKBAR
SUGHRA WILL PERISH, WEEPING IN LONELINESS

arabic text: (AKBAR KI JUDAYI ME NA JEE PAYEGI SUGHRA)
english translation text: SUGHRA WILL NOT BE ABLE TO LIVE BEING SEPARATED FROM AKBAR

arabic text: (AKBAR KO TASAWWUR ME, DULHA BHI BANAYENGI)\n(HUM JOLIYO(N) KO SEHRA) DIKHLAYEGI SUGHRA
english translation text: IN HER THOUGHTS (DREAMS) SHE WILL MAKE AKBAR A BRIDEGROOM\nSUGHRA WILL DISPLAY THE (WEDDING) GARLAND

arabic text: (AKBAR KE LIYE US PAL)\n(DEKHENGI KISI BHAYI, BEHEN KI JO MUHABBAT)\nTARAP JAAYEGI SUGHRA
english translation text: THE MOMENT SHE SEES THE AFFECTION BETWEEN ANOTHER BROTHER AND SISTER\nAKBAR AT THAT MOMENT, SUGHRA WILL YEARN TO SEE AKBAR

arabic text: (DUKH DARD KI MARI HAI, BABA KI BHI PYAARI HAI)\n(ZULMAT KE ANDHERO(N)\nME) BIKHARJAYEGI SUGHRA
english translation text: SHE HAS ENDURED PAIN (OF SEPARATION), SHE IS THE BELOVED OF HER FATHER\nSUGHRA WILL BE DEVASTATED IN THE DARKNESS OF OPPRESSION

arabic text: (DAADI KI LAHAD JAAYE, KABHI NANA KE ROZE)\n(TANHA HAI AKELI HAI)\nKAHA(N) JAYEGI SUGHRA
english translation text: SHE GOES TO HER GRANDMOTHER'S GRAVE, SOMETIMES TO HER GRANDFATHER'S GRAVE\nWHERE WILL SUGHRA GO, SHE IS LONELY AND ALONE

arabic text: (BEEMAR AGAR SUNLE, AKBAR KE LAGA NEZA)\n(MARJAYENGI YE KAISE)
english translation text: SUN PAYEGI SUGHRA\nWHAT IF THE UNWELL SUGHRA HEARS THAT AKBAR WAS KILLED WITH A SPEAR\nHOW WILL SUGHRA BEAR THIS( NEWS)? HOW WILL SHE DIE?

arabic text: (AY RAB-E-JAHAA(N)\n(AKBAR SE NA JITE JI)\nUSKO, ITNA TO BATAADE)
english translation text: MIL PAYEGI SUGHRA\nO LORD AT LEAST LET HER KNOW\nWHILE SUGHRA IS ALIVE, SHE WILL NEVER SEE AKBAR

arabic text: (IS AAS PA ZINDA HAI, AYEGA ALI AKBAR)\n(QADMO(N) KE NISHA(N) KAISE) MITTA PAYEGI SUGHRA
english translation text: SHE IS ALIVE IN THE HOPE THAT, ALI AKBAR WILL COME BACK\nHOW WILL SUGHRA ERASE THE FOOTPRINTS ( OF AKBAR)

arabic text: (HUJRA ALI AKBAR KA, SUGHRA KO RULAATA HAI)\n(VEERAN HAI GHAR SAARA) NA REH PAYEGI SUGHRA
english translation text: SUGHRA WEEPS AT THE SIGHT OF ALI AKBAR'S CHAMBER\nSUGHRA WILL NOT BE ABLE TO BEAR THE EMPTINESS IN HER HOUSE

arabic text: (KABHI RAHO(N) KO TAKTI HAI, KABHI HATHO(N) KO DEKHE)\n(IN HATHO(N) ME KYA MEHNDI) LAGA PAYEGI SUGHRA
english translation text: SOMETIMES SHE GAZES IN THE DISTANCE, SOMETIMES SHE LOOKS AT HER HANDS\nWILL SUGHRA BE ABLE TO APPLY MEHNDI ON HER HANDS

arabic text: (IS TARHA BAHAN KOYI, JUDA HO NA AKHI SE)\n('YAWAR' YE DUA MANGO)
english translation text: RUNG LAYEGI SUGHRA\nMAY NO SISTER EVER ENDURE A SEPARATION LIKE THIS FROM A BROTHER\n'YAWAR' PRAY, SUGHRA WILL GET WELL
